findings.title: Debug Mode Enabled in Production
findings.description: Debuggable flag allows external tools to attach to the application.
findings.impact: Complete application compromise, arbitrary code execution

findings.title: Application Backup Enabled
findings.description: Allows ADB backup command to extract application sandbox data.
findings.remediation: Set android:allowBackup='false' unless backup is essential

findings.title: Cleartext Network Traffic Allowed
findings.remediation: Remove cleartext traffic flag and use HTTPS exclusively

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_SMS
permissions.desc: Grants ability to capture multi-factor OTP tokens.

permissions.name: android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
permissions.desc: Allows malicious overlay hijacking for password harvesting.

findings.title: Hardcoded AWS Credentials
findings.description: AWS access keys found in source code.
findings.remediation: Remove keys from code, use AWS IAM roles

findings.title: Weak Cryptographic Hash - MD5
findings.remediation: Use SHA-256 or stronger hash functions

findings.title: Hardcoded Encryption Key
findings.remediation: Use key derivation functions and secure key storage

findings.title: Hardcoded Encryption Key
findings.remediation: Use key derivation functions and secure key storage

findings.title: Critical Code Execution Injection via exec()
findings.evidence: Tainted flow of variable 'user_data' to execution sink 'conn.execute()'
findings.description: Unsanitized user-controlled input reaches an execution sink. This allows high-impact code or query execution injections.
findings.impact: Remote code execution, file system takeover, database corruption
findings.remediation: Do not pass user variables directly to execution sinks. Sanitize input parameters or use safe parameterized queries.
